items.title: Nvidia shares slide as Trump's role in Jensen Huang's comeback questioned by US politicians
items.line: Nvidia's stock market value surged on the annoucement of Huang's reappointment, but some of the gains reversed in Tuesday trading.
items.body: Shares in Nvidia dipped on Tuesday as US politicans questioned President Donald Trump's role in the return of Jensen Huang as chief executive. Huang was handed back his job at the AI microchip maker on Monday less than two weeks after he was forced to resign following the revelations of extra marital affairs, one of which was with a suspected Chinese spy. Trump has said he played a big role in the 63-year-old's reinstatment, which has led to questions and backlash from US lawmakers.

items.title: Environment Canterbury asks Fonterra for more info on plan to dump 22m litres of raw milk
items.line: The diary giant has applied to vary its existing wastewater consents so it can dispose of surplus milk.
items.body: Environment Canterbury has asked Fonterra for more information on its application for consent to dump 22 million litres of raw milk . The diary giant had applied to the Canterbury Regional Council to vary, or add to, its existing wastewater consents so it can dispose of surplus milk . Fonterra's application stated the milk would be incorporated into existing wastewater systems or applied directly to land in the region.

items.title: ACT claims scrapping Māori seats would solve overhang woes
items.line: The party is pointing to Te Pāti Māori’s one-tick campaign as having started "the whole overhang debate
items.body: The ACT Party is pointing to the Māori seats as the cause of - and the solution to - the overhang problem. But Te Pāti Māori says it's trying to distract from a botched overhang campaign on the right, and removing the Māori seats won't fix MMP. On preliminary numbers this election National won seven overhang seats - which is when a political party wins more seats through electorates than its party vote would entitle it to - and Te Pāti Māori won four.

items.title: Police investigate unexplained death in west Auckland
items.line: Emergency services were called to New Lynn on Monday night after a body was found at a home.
items.body: Emergency services were called to Rimu Street in New Lynn at around 10.20pm on Monday after a body was found at a home. They are treating the death as unexplained, and forensic staff could be seen at the house early Tuesday morning. "A post-mortem examination will take place in due course as part of our enquiries," Detective Inspector Chris Barry said. "Residents can expect to see an ongoing Police presence in the area while a scene examination is carried out."

items.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
items.line: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.
items.body: Anchored in a Mediterranean harbour nearly 2,000 miles from Moscow, the Captain of Russia's corvette Merkury might well have thought his ship was safe from attack. It wasn't. The audacious and successful night-time attack in Benghazi , co-ordinated by Ukraine's SBU security agency and its armed forces, has raised the obvious question: is the Ukraine war spreading well beyond its borders?

items.title: ‘Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power’ Renewed for Season 4 at Amazon Prime Video
items.line: “The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power” has been renewed for Season 4 at Amazon Prime Video.
items.body: “ The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power ” has been renewed for Season 4 at Amazon Prime Video. The Tolkien series, which is set thousands of years before the books in Middle-earth, is in pre-production for the new season and will begin filming in spring 2027 at Shepperton Studios in the U.K.

items.title: Look Up This Week to See November's Full Beaver Moon—the First of Four Back-to-Back Supermoons Over the Coming Months
items.line: The next one will occur on Christmas Eve, which, according to a stricter supermoon definition, is a rare coincidence that hasn't happened since 1787
items.body: We’re in for a dazzling treat over the next few months. Four consecutive supermoons will grace our skies from November through February. The second in the series—and the last of 2026—will fall on Christmas Eve and represents the closest full moon to Earth since 2018, according to Live Science ’s Jamie Carter. The supermoon sequence starts with this month’s full moon on the 24th, which will reach peak illumination at 9:53 a.m. Eastern time.

items.title: Music Streamer Tidal Targets AI-Generated Music, Saying It Will Be “Rejected And Removed” Starting Next Month
items.line: Tidal, a formerly artist-backed music streamer once controlled by Jack Dorsey’s Block, is taking an aggressive stand against AI.
items.body: Tidal , a formerly artist-backed music streamer once controlled by Jack Dorsey’s Block, is taking an aggressive stand against AI . Citing a massive surge of artificially created music, the company on Tuesday announced a complete ban taking effect on December 9. As of that date, the company said in a post on X that any wholly AI track detected on the platform will be “rejected and removed.”

items.title: RNZ Chief People Officer Sarah Neilson leaves amid financial crisis
items.line: The news of Sarah Neilson’s departure was made in a message to staff on Tuesday afternoon.
items.body: RNZ's human resources boss Sarah Neilson is leaving the public broadcaster, the third senior executive to depart amid its financial crisis. The Crown entity confirmed on Tuesday that Neilson, its chief people officer, would finish on Friday. Her departure follows those of chief executive Paul Thompson and chief financial officer Hilary Parker, as an independent inquiry looms into RNZ's shock $11.8 million loss this last financial year.

items.title: TVNZ staff call off 24-hour strike
items.line: Union members were due to walk off the job for 24 hours from 12.01am Wednesday, but this has now been averted.
items.body: A spokesperson for the union says progress was made during mediation this afternoon and an improved offer has will be taken back to members. TVNZ staff had earlier issued a strike notice for 24 hours tomorrow over a pay rise dispute. Staff were seeking a 5 percent pay rise, rather than the 2.5 percent TVNZ had offered. TVNZ said it had been in constructive bargaining discussions since July, but had not reached an agreement.

items.title: Cricket: Black Caps face 'a war of attrition' to save India test
items.line: The best of the batting conditions are over as the Black Caps attempt to save the first test against India.
items.body: The best of the batting conditions are likely to be over as the Black Caps attempt to save the first test against India. New Zealand will resume their second innings on 119 for two, still trailing India by 233 runs and facing 90 overs on what could be a variable wicket on the final day at the Basin Reserve. "We're pretty behind the game, obviously," Rachin Ravindra said at the end of the day. "It was a good period to get through two down."

items.title: Former Silver Ferns captain Julie Carter remembered as competitive, clever and committed
items.line: Former Silver Ferns captain Julie Carter remembered as competitive, clever and committed.
items.body: "Competitive" and "committed" are some of the words teammates of former Silver Ferns captain Julie Carter are using to describe her, as news of her death reaches the far corners of the netball community. Netball New Zealand on Monday said it was deeply saddened to share the news that Carter had died, aged 60. "Jules", or "JC" as she was often referred by her teammates, played 50 Tests for New Zealand between 1986 and 1993.

items.title: Nicalis removes AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after player backlash
items.line: Nicalis has pulled AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players discovered it in the game's latest update, prompting a wave of negative Steam reviews.
items.body: Nicalis has pulled AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ after players discovered it in the game's latest update, prompting a wave of negative Steam reviews. The music - tied to a run themed around Grand Theft Auto 6 - released on November 19, the same day GTA 6 launched. The following day, a player claimed the music was "100% generated by Suno (AI) (with proof)," highlighting tracks whose metadata referenced the AI music tool Suno.

items.title: GTA 6 was the "biggest launch in PlayStation history", with the highest number of concurrent players ever
items.line: Christmas did not come early for Sony, but it came close: the firm has declared that GTA 6 was the largest game launch in the platform's history, driving a record number of concurrent players on its…
items.body: Christmas did not come early for Sony, but it came close: the firm has declared that GTA 6 was the largest game launch in the platform's history, driving a record number of concurrent players on its November 19th launch, although the number of new consoles playing the game fell short of year-end highs. A post on the PlayStation Blog said the game has attracted more than 39 million unique players since launch, who have cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay. The average total playtime was 17.4 hours, the firm said.

items.title: Black Ferns to venture into the regions
items.line: The Black Ferns will play in Nelson and Timaru for the first time next year.
items.body: The Black Ferns will play in Nelson and Timaru for the first time next year. The Black Ferns' Pacific Four Series begins at home against World Rugby's third-ranked side, Canada, at Trafalgar Park - the first Black Ferns Test in Nelson. The team then heads south to Fraser Park in Timaru to face the USA, marking the team's debut in the town. The O'Reilly Cup Test against Australia at Palmy Arena will take the Black Ferns back to Palmerston North in August after a 28-year wait.

items.title: Injuries mount for under fire All Blacks with Will Jordan heading home
items.line: The All Blacks will be without star wing Will Jordan for this weekend's rematch with England at Twickenham, while captain Codie Taylor is in doubt.
items.body: The All Blacks will be without star wing Will Jordan for this weekend's rematch with England at Twickenham, while captain Codie Taylor is in doubt. Jordan, who returned from a hamstring strain in last weekend's record loss to the English , has reaggravated the injury and is heading home, while Taylor has a tight calf. Chiefs hooker Samisoni Taukei'aho has recovered from a calf injury of his own and has joined the squad as cover for Taylor.

items.title: Kalshi makes “difficult decision” to halt Utah trading after losing court fights
items.line: Kalshi’s pause in Utah draws cheers as critics bash ads and boo insider trading.
items.body: Kalshi’s pause in Utah draws cheers as critics bash ads and boo insider trading. Kalshi made the “difficult decision” to pause operations in Utah after losing a court fight to block the state’s ongoing enforcement actions under Utah gambling laws, Kalshi spokesperson Jacki McGavick said Monday. It seems Kalshi’s legal troubles in Utah have become too much for the prediction market platform to gamble on continued operations there.

items.title: Porsche 718 Boxster prototype drive: This electric roadster is real
items.line: Technical details are still limited, but we already know it's fun to drive.
items.body: Technical details are still limited, but we already know it’s fun to drive. It wasn’t until I was stuck in traffic on the way back from a run up and down some canyon roads that I realized just how low Porsche’s upcoming all-electric 718 Boxster truly is. I was idly looking around at the other cars, doing the math on the EV adoption rate in this small sample of Los Angeles gridlock (roughly 50 percent, impressively) when I noticed that I was eye-level with a Tesla Model Y door handle.

items.title: NRL Fan Ideas Hub launched: Send us your suggestions now
Hudson Young’s departure sees Raiders prepare FOUR new contracts
items.line: The Raiders have moved on from Young quickly.
items.body: The Canberra Raiders are set to launch a quartet of contract extension offers after receiving clarity over the future of their salary cap with Hudson Young's departure locked in. Young had been in negotiations with the Raiders for months, but a deadline leading into November 1 that failed to be met saw the Green Machine take his deal off the table. Young, who has since toured Port Moresby and signed with the NRL expansion club that will be based there, is still likely - although not a guarantee - to see out 2027 in the nation's capital.

items.title: AJ Brimson confirms future, Titans departure locked in
items.line: The star fullback has a new club.
items.body: The PNG Chiefs have confirmed AJ Brimson will join as the tenth player for 2028, with his Gold Coast Titans departure locked in. Brimson has been looking for a way out of the Titans for some time, with the club unable to secure him as the number one jumper. With Keano Kini taking over there, and Jayden Campbell preferred as the first-choice five-eighth, Brimson has been shuffled out to the centres on a majority of occasions.

items.title: Ben Hunt’s likely 2027 role revealed as Broncos grapple big spine questions
items.line: The club is looking to find their Adam Reynolds replacement.
items.body: Brisbane Broncos have a favourite for an Adam Reynolds replacement for the 2027 season. The Broncos are looking to return to the finals after finishing 14th this past season, with 2025 being their premiership-winning season. In 2027, the club will not have Payne Haas and Adam Reynolds , who have left. Payne Haas went to the South Sydney Rabbitohs , while Reynolds confirmed his retirement.

items.title: Sam Walker makes Roosters call after contract talk chaos
items.line: The Roosters halfback has confirmed where he wants to play for 2027.
items.body: Sydney Roosters halfback Sam Walker has made his call about whether he will play for the club in 2027 after chaotic contract talks. After months of negotiations, the Roosters released a statement in October confirming Walker would not be at the club after 2027. That came as a shock after both parties seemed to be agreeing on terms for a new contract. However, reports indicated Walker asked for more money and time to decide on his future at the club.

Jamal Fogarty makes call about his future with Manly
items.line: The Sea Eagles are reportedly interested in releasing their halfback.
items.body: Manly Sea Eagles halfback Jamal Fogarty has decided where his future lies after reports surfaced that the club wanted to release the veteran playmaker. Reports have recently surfaced that the club wants to release players on massive contracts to create salary cap flexibility. Fogarty, along with Luke Brooks and Ethan Bullemor , have been Manly's candidates to find new clubs. According to Fox Sports , Fogarty wants to play out his contract at the Northern Beaches after reports surfaced of a swap with the Tigers for Latu Fainu .
